basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 25-year-old digital nomad currently traveling around South America. I have a passion for anime, especially 'Naruto', and I'm always on the lookout for the next great series to binge. When I'm not working remotely in digital marketing, you'll find me exploring new cultures or planning my next flight (I've had my fair share of experiences with United Airlines, both good and bad!). I usually log into Reddit during the afternoons or late at night, depending on the time zone I'm in. Single and loving the freedom to travel and explore!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Marketing, which I obtained from a state university. My love for anime and travel comes from years of personal interest and exploration. I've picked up a lot about different cultures through my travels and am pretty savvy with airline deals and travel hacks.
